verdict.rationale: The Python SDK provides get_search_context(), which returns a context string that the docs say "you can feed directly into your RAG Application". qna_search() adds concise answers described as "perfect for usage by LLMs", so the core of the story is directly supported. missing for 10: documented controls for sizing the context (token or length limits), explicit evidence of relevance ranking or scores on results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG output quality.
